facts.statement: The genus Arenipiscis was described by Young in 1981.
The only known species within the genus is Arenipiscis westolli.
The holotype specimen, identified as ANU 35616, consists of an incomplete skull roof.
facts.quote: The holotype specimen, ANU 35616, is an incomplete skull-roof.

facts.statement: The name Arenipiscis means "sand fish" because its armor has a granular texture created by tiny bumps on the dermal surfaces.
facts.quote: The generic name, meaning "sand fish," refers to how the dermal surfaces of the armor have a pattern of tiny bumps, creating a granular texture.

facts.statement: Arenipiscis lived during the Emsian stage, between 410.62 and 393.47 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Emsian to Emsian (410.62 to 393.47 million years ago)

facts.statement: Arenipiscis belongs to the parent group Arthrodira.
Arenipiscis is classified in the class Placodermi.

rejected.statement: Arenipiscis westolli is an extinct buchanosteid arthrodire placoderm.
